title: Science sandboxes measure the scientific capability of AI agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.30165v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific progress depends not only on finding solutions, but on learning the rules that explain why they work and using that understanding to design better experiments. We introduce science sandboxes, a framework for studying this capability in AI agents through repeated cycles of experimentation, feedback, and hypothesis revision. Science sandboxes invite an agent to query the natural world in different ways, ranging from "wet" physical experiments, to "damp" predictive models trained on empirical data, to "dry" invented rules. By establishing a common experimental loop and a protocol for evaluating agents within it, science sandboxes allow assessment of both quantitative performance on specific metrics and qualitative scientific reasoning, across a spectrum of empirical verifiability. translated_title: 科学沙盒：衡量AI智能体科学能力的框架
translated_abstract: 科学进步不仅依赖于找到解决方案，还依赖于学习解释这些方案为何有效的规则，并利用这种理解来设计更好的实验。我们提出了“科学沙盒”，这是一个通过重复的实验、反馈和假设修正循环来研究AI智能体这种能力的框架。科学沙盒邀请智能体以不同的方式探究自然世界，从“湿”的物理实验，到基于经验数据训练的“潮”预测模型，再到“干”的人为设定规则。通过建立统一的实验循环和在其中评估智能体的协议，科学沙盒能够在一系列经验可验证性的范围内，同时评估智能体在特定指标上的定量表现和定性的科学推理能力。在本文中，我们在两个生物学场景中实例化了这一框架——调控基因组学模型和蛋白质适应性预测，并检验了相关能力。
tldr: 该论文提出了“科学沙盒”框架，通过实验-反馈-假设修正的循环过程来评估AI智能体的科学探究能力，并在调控基因组学和蛋白质适应性预测两个生物学场景中进行了实例化验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "science sandboxes," a framework for measuring AI agents' scientific capability through iterative cycles of experimentation, feedback, and hypothesis revision, instantiated in two biological settings: regulatory genomics and protein fitness prediction.
